
##### Return journeys

The movement matrix is a square matrix whose $kl^{th}$ entry,
$m(k,l)$, is defined as the count of outings from home in community
district $k$ to a gathering in community district $l$. Say $d^H(i)$ is
the home community district of participant $i$. 




$$
m(j,k) = \sum_i D(i,j) \sum_{k }( \Psi(i,k) - D(i,k) )
$$
